scope: Production public WASM export and pinned Chromium PDF; raw artifacts are retained in the linked Actions runs.
limitations: Word behavior captures used substituted Times New Roman and are not font-matched oracles.
Controls prove full page-raster identity, not PDF-byte or HTML/PageMap payload identity.
Native Word and LibreOffice differ in continuous-section margin geometry; full-page visual scores and close-match status are reported without claiming equivalence.
screenshotMethod: All actual PDF pages independently rasterized with pdftoppm -r 96 -cropbox -png, checked against inspected PDF page counts, and matched pair images checked pixel-identical. Full pages resized to 50% with Lanczos, generated labels outside page areas; blank cells indicate no corresponding page.
